prompt: Generating dry HCl gas and testing it against dry litmus paper produces no colour change, but moist litmus paper does change colour. This shows that:
options: HCl is not an acid at all
Litmus paper does not work on gases
HCl only reacts with moist air
HCl's acidic behaviour depends on the presence of water
explanation: Dry HCl gas alone has no acidic character — its H+ only separates and becomes acidic in the presence of water.
